description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter called NotesAdapter for displaying a list of notes in an Android application. It handles binding note data to views, managing a list of Note objects, and user interaction callbacks.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView Adapter for displaying a list of notes, handling view creation, data binding, and user interactions.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class that binds note data to the individual item views within the RecyclerView.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Replaces the current list of notes with a new list and refreshes the RecyclerView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of note items.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds note data to the view components and sets click and long-click listeners.
